name: ES-CL Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation
description: Compares ES-CL 5-min rolling correlation (60-bar window) across two sub-sessions: pre-RTH (8:00-9:30 AM ET) and RTH open (9:30-11:30 AM ET). Tests whether pre-market cross-asset correlation is noisier than the regular session open. Includes overlaid correlation time series, per-session distribution histograms, decorrelation event markers for both windows, and side-by-side summary statistics.
source:
# ES-CL Rolling Correlation: Pre-RTH vs RTH Open
# Pre-RTH: 8:00-9:30 AM ET | RTH Open: 9:30-11:30 AM ET
# 60-bar rolling correlation on 5-min returns
# Primary asset: ES futures | Reference: CL futures

# --- Data ---
ts = index()()

# ES: primary asset
es_raw = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es_cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=5Min, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(es_raw.o, es_raw.h, es_raw.l, es_raw.c, es_raw.v, es_raw.oi, es_raw.s)

# CL: reference futures
cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(timeframe=5Min, s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# --- Two Sub-Session Windows ---
# Pre-RTH: 8:00-9:30 AM ET (EU/US overlap before equity open)
pre_rth = session_window(session=Session(start='08:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York'))(es_cont.o, es_cont.h, es_cont.l, es_cont.c)

# RTH Open: 9:30-11:30 AM ET (first 2 hours of equity session)
rth_open = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York'))(es_cont.o, es_cont.h, es_cont.l, es_cont.c)

# --- Returns (1-bar = 5-min returns) ---
es_ret = returns(period=1)(es_cont.c)
cl_ret = returns(period=1)(ffill(cl_cont.c))

# --- Rolling Correlation (60-bar window) ---
corr_raw = rolling_corr(window=60)(es_ret, cl_ret)

# Isolate correlation to each sub-session
corr_pre = where(pre_rth.active, corr_raw)
corr_rth = where(rth_open.active, corr_raw)

# End-of-session snapshots for stats (sparse — avoids S48 ffill distortion)
corr_pre_close = where(pre_rth.closed, corr_raw)
corr_rth_close = where(rth_open.closed, corr_raw)

# --- Event Markers: Decorrelation in Both Sub-Sessions ---
# Pre-RTH decorrelation (corr crosses below zero)
corr_pre_prev = corr_pre >> 1
is_decor_pre = is_valid(corr_pre) and is_valid(corr_pre_prev) and corr_pre_prev >= 0 and corr_pre < 0

# RTH open decorrelation
corr_rth_prev = corr_rth >> 1
is_decor_rth = is_valid(corr_rth) and is_valid(corr_rth_prev) and corr_rth_prev >= 0 and corr_rth < 0

# Combined decorrelation flag
is_decorrelation = is_decor_pre or is_decor_rth
session_label = conditional_select(is_decor_pre, "Pre-RTH", is_decor_rth, "RTH Open", "")
corr_at_event = conditional_select(is_decor_pre, corr_pre, is_decor_rth, corr_rth, 0)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='ES-CL Decorrelation',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Session', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='ES Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(session_label, corr_at_event, es_cont.c, cl_cont.c, is_decorrelation)

# --- Output 1: Overlaid Correlation Time Series ---
# ffill_day for rendering continuity within each session
corr_pre_render = ffill_day(corr_pre)
corr_rth_render = ffill_day(corr_rth)

xy_lines(
    title='Is Pre-Market Noisier? ES-CL Correlation by Sub-Session',
    category='Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Rolling Correlation (60-bar)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Pre-RTH (8:00-9:30)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RTH Open (9:30-11:30)', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Moderate (+0.5)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-1.0, to=0.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.05, label='Negative'),
        PlotBand(from=0.0, to=1.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05, label='Positive')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts.value, y_values=(corr_pre_render, corr_rth_render))

# --- Output 2: Pre-RTH Correlation Distribution ---
histogram(
    title='Pre-RTH Session-Close Correlation Distribution (8:00-9:30)',
    category='Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation',
    bins=25,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_label='Correlation at Session Close',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(corr_pre_close)

# --- Output 3: RTH Open Correlation Distribution ---
histogram(
    title='RTH Open Session-Close Correlation Distribution (9:30-11:30)',
    category='Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation',
    bins=25,
    fill_color=Color.Slate,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_label='Correlation at Session Close',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=3
)(corr_rth_close)

# --- Output 4: Side-by-Side Summary Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Pre-RTH vs RTH Correlation',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Which Session Is Noisier? Session-Close Correlation Stats',
        row_size=4, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Median', 'Std Dev (Noise)', 'Min / Max', 'Session Count'],
        col_headers=['Pre-RTH (8-9:30)', 'RTH Open (9:30-11:30)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    order=4
)(corr_pre_close, corr_rth_close, corr_pre_close, corr_rth_close, corr_pre_close, corr_rth_close, corr_pre_close, corr_rth_close)
